WITH user_rank AS (
                SELECT
                    g.user_id,
                    u.username,
                    COUNT(*) AS signed_correct_count,
                    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS position
                FROM
                    gameEvents AS g
                INNER JOIN
                    users AS u ON g.user_id = u.user_id
                WHERE
                    is_correct = TRUE
                GROUP BY
                    user_id
            )
            SELECT
                user_id,
                username,
                CAST(signed_correct_count AS UNSIGNED) AS correct_count,
                CAST(position AS UNSIGNED) AS position
            FROM user_rank
            WHERE user_id = ?
